<commits>
4ac1a8089b ci: Enable Boost.MultiIndex invariant-checking mode

From the Boost.MultiIndex docs:
[quoted text omitted]

Define it in the two jobs that already define
BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE. The "MSAN, fuzz" job also defines
safe mode but is left unchanged, as invariant checking would push it
past the 240-minute limit on the Warp runner.

<patch>
diff --git a/ci/test/00_setup_env_i686.sh b/ci/test/00_setup_env_i686.sh
index 03e3d374e6..5de99b0ea2 100755
--- a/ci/test/00_setup_env_i686.sh
+++ b/ci/test/00_setup_env_i686.sh
@@ -18,6 +18,6 @@ export CI_LIMIT_STACK_SIZE=1
 printf -v BITCOIN_CONFIG "%q " \
  --preset=dev-mode \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
- -DAPPEND_CPPFLAGS=-DBOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE
+ -DAPPEND_CPPFLAGS="-DBOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE -DBOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING"
 export BITCOIN_CONFIG
 export BITCOIN_CMD="bitcoin -m" # Used in functional tests
diff --git a/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_previous_releases.sh b/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_previous_releases.sh
index 65173e7e73..a7507052d2 100755
--- a/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_previous_releases.sh
+++ b/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_previous_releases.sh
@@ -23,5 +23,5 @@ printf -v BITCOIN_CONFIG "%q " \
  -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG="-g2 -O2" \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-funsigned-char -Werror" \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG="-g2 -O2" \
- -DAPPEND_CPPFLAGS=-DBOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE
+ -DAPPEND_CPPFLAGS="-DBOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE -DBOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING"
 export BITCOIN_CONFIG
diff --git a/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_fuzz_with_msan.sh b/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_fuzz_with_msan.sh
index a0beb72377..6ad814d5b7 100755
--- a/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_fuzz_with_msan.sh
+++ b/ci/test/00_setup_env_native_fuzz_with_msan.sh
@@ -23,6 +23,9 @@ printf -v BITCOIN_CONFIG "%q " \
  -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG= \
  -DBUILD_FOR_FUZZING=ON \
  -DSANITIZERS=memory \
+`# Unlike the other jobs that define BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE,` \
+`# BOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_INVARIANT_CHECKING is not defined here, as it` \
+`# would push the job past the 240-minute limit on the Warp runner.` \
  -DAPPEND_CPPFLAGS="-DBOOST_MULTI_INDEX_ENABLE_SAFE_MODE -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE"  `# _FORTIFY_SOURCE is not compatible with MSAN`
 export BITCOIN_CONFIG
 export USE_INSTRUMENTED_LIBCPP="MemoryWithOrigins"

</patch>
